title: Logger drops its color dependency for an inlined NO_COLOR/FORCE_COLOR check (benign hard-negative)
intent: Reading NO_COLOR, FORCE_COLOR, and TERM to decide whether to emit ANSI colors is the standard terminal convention, and nothing read leaves the process, yet code.credential-access fires at medium on the modified file. Guards the AI failure where the reviewer calls that deterministic finding a likely false positive in its own text but still files it as a high finding.
